strings.Used for streams that need custom header: E faʻaaoga mo stream e manaʻomia ai headers faʻapitoa, ma e auina atu ai trailer pe a tatala MKCinema o se faila.
strings.Used for “Where to watch” on title pages: E faʻaaoga mo le "Mea e matamata ai" i itulau ulutala. E manaʻomia lau TMDB key (Faʻatulagaga › Amataga, i lalo o le Ambient Mode, po o lalo).
strings.Uses the age rating where you live (US,: E faʻaaoga le faʻailoga tausaga o le mea e te nofo ai (US, Pasila, Initia, UK po o Siamani), a leai o le US. O ulutala e leai se faʻailoga e na o Ata faʻagaoioi ma Aiga. Faʻailoga: TMDB ma Wikidata.
strings.Uses your TV’s own video hardware. MKCin: E faʻaaoga meafaigaluega vitio a lau TV. E filifili pea e MKCinema le punaʻoa, auina au upu i lalo ma manatua le mea na e tuʻu ai.
strings.VLC and mpv on a computer have no web li: E leai se sootaga upega tafailagi o VLC ma mpv i luga o se komepiuta, o lea filifili le faila playlist ona tatala ai lea i lau mea taʻalo masani.
strings.VLC, debrid and your first sources: VLC, debrid ma au punaʻoa muamua
strings.Version, MKCinema's own license, and the: Lomiga, laisene a MKCinema, ma polokalame, mataitusi ma auaunaga a isi e faʻaaogaina.
strings.Vocal Clarity Boost: Faʻamalosia le Manino o le Leo
strings.Watch progress (Continue watching): Alualu i luma o le matamata (Faʻaauau le matamata)
strings.Watched history (films and episodes you: Talafaasolopito o le matamata (ata tifaga ma vaega ua e faʻamaeʻaina)
strings.What you skip and what you keep watching: O mea e te faʻamisi ma mea e te matamata pea e aʻoaʻo ai, na o lenei masini: o ituaiga e te tumau ai e sili ona aliali mai, ma e sii atu le faamalama i taimi na e nofo ai.
strings.What's on each service: O le a le mea o loo i auaunaga taitasi
strings.When no subtitle exists in your language: A leai se upu i lalo i lau gagana, e faaliliu e MKCinema le mea sili e maua ma faʻailoga Translated. E faʻaaoga le faaliliu o lau polokalame suʻesuʻe pe a iai; a leai e faaliliuina laina e le auaunaga faaliliu a MKCinema.
strings.With more than one debrid key saved, you: Pe a sili atu i le tasi le debrid key ua teu, e mafai ona e filifili iinei po o fea auaunaga e muamua.
strings.X-Ray summaries and cast photos: Aotelega X-Ray ma ata o tagata taʻalo
strings.You can add more services later under Se: E mafai ona e faʻaopoopo isi auaunaga mulimuli ane i Faʻatulagaga › Debrid. E nofo lau key i lenei masini.
strings.Your favorites: Mea e sili ona e fiafia i ai
strings.Your server's address, username and pass: Le tuatusi, igoa faʻaaoga ma upu faataga o lau server. E auina atu na o lau server le upu faataga ma e le teuina.
strings.Your setup lives in this browser (and yo: O lau faʻatulagaga o loo i lenei polokalame suʻesuʻe (ma lau akauni, pe a e saini). E sii e le Setup Cloner mea uma i se isi masini i le code e tasi.
strings.Your watchlist, your lists and everythin: Lau lisi matamata, au lisi ma mea uma ua e amataina. Pe a e saini, latou te mulimuli ia te oe i masini uma.
strings.“Watching” and the title on your Discord: "Watching" ma le ulutala i lau profile Discord aʻo taʻalo se mea. E manaʻomia ina tatala le app Discord i lenei komepiuta.
strings.If a source has not started after 10 s,: Afai e le amata se punaʻoa i le 10 s, iai se mea sese, pe tu mo le 12 s, e faʻaauau e le isi punaʻoa sili i le nofoaga lava e tasi.
